nodes.name: 🔔 Inbox Outlook Trigger
nodes.notes:
Branch A — incoming customer emails. Raw output.

nodes.name: 📧 Normalize Incoming Email
nodes.notes:
v6: no subject filter — all emails processed.
Always returns 1 item with shouldPost + skipReason.
Filters only: own support email, empty body, draft, no conversationId.

nodes.name: ✅ Incoming Should Post?
nodes.notes:
TRUE (shouldPost=true) → output 0 → 💬 Post Request to Slack.
FALSE (shouldPost=false) → output 1 → dead end.
Check skipReason in Normalize Incoming Email output to understand why email was filtered.

nodes.name: 💬 Post Request to Slack
nodes.notes:
Posts incoming request card to C0ATU9ZD2UF (#support_ai_test).
Only reached when shouldPost=true.
TODO: Select Slack credential. TODO: Update channel ID for production.

nodes.name: 🧷 Store Slack Thread Mapping
nodes.notes:
Saves conversationId → {channelId, threadTs, requestId, senderEmail, subject} in $getWorkflowStaticData('global').
Branch A ends here.

nodes.name: 📤 Sent Outlook Trigger
nodes.notes:
Branch B — manager sent replies. Polls SentItems.
TODO: Same OAuth2 credential as Branch A.
If 'SentItems' fails, try 'Sent Items' or 'Отправленные'.

nodes.name: 📧 Normalize Sent Reply
nodes.notes:
v5: matches conversationId from staticData. Returns [] if no match.
Dedup via processedSentMessageIds ring-buffer (max 500).
Strips quoted reply history and Outlook mobile footer.

nodes.name: 🔎 Find Slack Thread Mapping
nodes.notes: Validates slackChannelId, slackThreadTs, sentReplyText all present. Returns [] otherwise.

nodes.name: 🧵 Post Final Reply to Slack Thread
nodes.notes:
Posts manager reply ONLY in thread via thread_ts — not as new main channel message.

If thread_ts missing in your n8n version, move it to additionalFields.
